title: IoTASK – Converting “dumb” equipment into smart, digital and connected systems
excerpt: IoTASK converts “dumb” and “disconnected” equipment into smart, digital and connected systems.
content:
IoTASK converts “dumb” and “disconnected” equipment into smart, digital and connected systems.

The digitization effort in the construction sector is strongly conditioned by the difficulty of converting work equipment (machinery), buildings, roads or railroads so that data can be extracted and connected to the Internet of Things (IoT).

IoTASK aims to create agnostic IoT solutions (which do not depend on brands or types of equipment) to convert unintelligent and disconnected equipment into cyber-physical systems capable of capturing physical variables (temperature, electricity, water or fuel consumption, etc.) and making the data available in a way that allows interconnection and interoperability with intelligent decision support systems or data science platforms.

IoTASK aims to develop high TRL experimental versions of the devices and their platforms. To this end, it will explore sensors, communication technologies, energy autonomy, reliability, redundancy and data platforms.

Main Activities

  • Development of agnostic IoT solutions
